newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico shares pare gains, but underpinned by FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Mexico shares pare gains, but underpinned by FOMC.

text.p: Mexican stocks had trimmed earlier gains at late afternoon dealing on Wednesday, but were nonetheless steady and heading for another record close, traders said.

Traders said the Federal Open Market Committee announcement it would leave U.S. interest rates unchanged did not affect the market, as investors had already discounted the decision. The news nonetheless supported the market.
The leading IPC share index was up 38.05 points, or 0.84 percent, at 4,546.84.
